user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts. Active commitments: analytical_spatial_unit=Centre County census tracts

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Aggregate hospital beds by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute total hospital beds within each Centre County census tract using the hospital point layer and tract polygon layer.
workflow_steps.instructions: Use input_1 as the hospital point layer and input_2 as the census tract polygon layer. Sum the observed BEDS field from input_1 for points within each input_2 polygon. Preserve the tract geometries and produce a GeoPackage vector layer. Runtime QC must confirm Centre County spatial coverage and ground the resulting total-beds field name for downstream mapping.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital beds choropleth map
workflow_steps.purpose: Generate an interactive choropleth map of total hospital beds by Centre County census tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Map the aggregated_tracts GeoPackage as a choropleth. Runtime QC must identify the generated field representing total hospital beds and populate the mapping field parameter from observed output schema; do not infer a field name in advance.

requirements.scope: The hospital point input must contain the numeric hospital-bed field required for summation.
